prompt: A unified team competed in the 1992 Summer Olympic games. How many years old was the first leader of the largest member nation of that team at the time of the game?
answer:
The Unified Team’s largest member nation was **Russia**. Its first president and leader at the 1992 Barcelona Olympics was **Boris Yeltsin**, born **February 1, 1931**.

During the Olympics (July 25–August 9, 1992), Yeltsin was **61 years old**.
